meta.name: paper-search-usage
meta.description: This skill should be used when user asks to "search for papers", "find research papers", "search arXiv", "search PubMed", "find academic papers", "search IEEE", "search Scopus", or "look up scientific literature".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 搜索并查找学术论文与科学文献
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要快速查找学术论文或科学文献
copy.tagline_en: Search and find academic papers and scientific literature
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly find academic papers or scientific literature

howto.what: Claude会调用学术论文搜索工具，根据关键词、作者或主题在arXiv、PubMed、IEEE等平台查找论文，并返回相关文献列表。
howto.when: 当你说“搜索论文”“查找研究论文”“搜arXiv”等要求，或提到查找学术文献时触发。

say.text: 帮我搜一下关于Transformer的arXiv论文。
say.note: 会调用arXiv搜索工具返回结果。

say.text: 搜索IEEE上关于5G网络的文章。

howto.what_en: Claude will invoke academic paper search tools to find papers by keywords, authors, or topics across platforms such as arXiv, PubMed, IEEE, etc., and return relevant literature lists.
howto.when_en: When the user asks to search for papers, find research papers, search arXiv, or look up scientific literature, the skill activates.

say_en.text: Help me find arXiv papers about Transformers.
Search PubMed for literature on COVID-19.
